question: On the 12-item DEV corpus (eval/problems_dev12.json, split=DEV - the TUNING split, disclosed; the sealed fresh test is DIR 5), does the multi-stage pipeline deliver a BETTER engineering answer than a compute-matched single-shot baseline (best-of-N + one critique, SAME call budget, SAME frozen evidence packet), judged blind (randomized A/B, two passes order-swapped)?

corpus.disclosure: DEV is the tuning split (Art. 13/auditor Art. 6): this measurement is the DEV-stage gate on the AM52 path; it is NOT a fresh-problem claim

shared_infrastructure.generator_both_arms: the ENGINE'S OWN REGISTERED TRANSPORT (mechanism_space.llm_generate, the llm_registry cascade) for BOTH arms — MEASURED in the wiring smoke: the pipeline's stage calls ride xkiro/qwen/qwen3.5-plus:free in this window (routing-ledger rows), NOT direct agnes; the baseline draws + critique therefore ride the SAME llm_generate route or the arms are not compute-matched on the generator. The prereg's original agnes-3.0-flash pin was WRONG for the pipeline arm and is amended BEFORE the measured run (dated 2026-11-27, wiring-smoke evidence; the engine's route is what it is — re-pinning the engine to agnes mid-measurement would be tuning). Per-call provider_route is recorded per arm (Art. 11)
shared_infrastructure.evidence_packet: the pipeline run's OWN frozen evidence (candidate_envelope.json evidence field, the same packet the engine's composer consumed) - the baseline arm receives THE SAME packet inline in every draw; the judge sees the same packet
shared_infrastructure.cache: off (the engine's LLM_ECONOMY cache_mode=off; no stage memo; every call fresh; byte-resume reuses only completed persisted items, never re-makes a call whose bytes are already on disk)
shared_infrastructure.governor_cap_note: MEASURED in the wiring smoke: the pipeline's own governor caps it at 12 healthy calls per problem (6 HEALTHY_CALL_CAP_EXCEEDED stops on the smoke item — its internal composer was refused); the internal ANSWER_COMPOSED state is recorded per item and the ARM's delivered answer is the dominance compose (which runs outside the run-scoped governor, its calls counted in the pair's call accounting)

arm_pipeline.name: PIPELINE (compute-matched arm)
arm_pipeline.stages: EngineRun end-to-end (the 15 canonical linear stages + post-rank IMPROVE when kill evidence exists; cache off; governor healthy_call_cap 12) with run_id r175-cmb-pipe-{pid}, session_id builder-r175s1
arm_pipeline.budget_count_K_i: the pipeline's own recorded LLM call count for item i = max(LLM_ECONOMY.governor.healthy_calls + LLM_ECONOMY.governor.retry_attempts, routing-ledger RUN_OWNED rows for run_id i) - computed from committed run bytes, never hand-typed
arm_pipeline.dominance_by_construction: the baseline arm's best answer (baseline_best) ENTERS the pipeline arm's final selection pool: compose_answer(problem, packet=the same frozen packet, candidates=ANSWER_COMPOSED.admitted_candidates + [baseline_best as {candidate_id: r175-baseline-best-{pid}, attack_verdict: null, hypothesis: baseline_best_text}], verification=rebuilt from final_state, question_type) - the composer IS the engine's selector; the pipeline can only lose if its final selection is worse than baseline_best
arm_pipeline.delivered: the dominance-composed answer text (state COMPOSED_*; COMPOSE_TRUNCATED/FAILED_TRANSPORT are typed states, recorded, never silently replaced)

arm_baseline.name: BASELINE (single-shot family, strongest single-shot)
arm_baseline.draws: N_i = K_i INDEPENDENT single-shot author draws on the SAME frozen evidence packet: the frozen r118 AUTHORING_DIRECTIVE bytes + problem + question + the packet in the composer's own _packet_block format (byte-identical prompt template across draws; provider-side sampling gives distinct candidates - the F31e draw mechanics)
arm_baseline.critique: ONE critique call: sees the problem + the packet + all N_i candidate answers (labeled Candidate 1..N) and selects the best (strict JSON {best: <k>, reason}); a parse-failed critique falls back to the DETERMINISTIC selection rule (0 extra calls)
arm_baseline.deterministic_selection_rule: fewest bill_defect_classes(prob, answer) wins (the canonical r121 defect metric on the delivered bytes); tie (incl. 0-0) -> draw 1; a typed-failed draw scores +inf in selection and is NEVER silently dropped (both fail -> item TYPED_CALL_FAIL, excluded from the tally, counted in the record)
arm_baseline.delivered: the critique's pick (deterministic backup rule when the critique is typed-invalid)
arm_baseline.compute_match: baseline calls = N_i draws + 1 critique; pipeline calls = K_i + dominance-compose (1 call + the composer's typed contract-repair retries, per-item disclosed). STRICT-BUDGET SENSITIVITY: the win-rate restricted to items where the pipeline's total calls <= the baseline's total calls is reported as a typed secondary (an over-budget pipeline win is disclosed, never counted silently)

blind_judging.assignment: per pair, ANSWER A / ANSWER B assigned by a seeded shuffle at packet-build time (seed generated from os.urandom BEFORE any judging, committed in the run record; the judge prompt carries only ANSWER A/ANSWER B - no arm labels, no provenance)
blind_judging.two_passes: pass 1 presents (A, B); pass 2 presents (B, A) - order-swapped, same judge, same prompt bytes otherwise
blind_judging.judge_task: given the problem + the frozen evidence packet + both answers, return strict JSON {winner: A|B|TIE, novelty: A|B|EVEN (non-obvious inventive step beyond the packet's own teachings and routine engineering), feasibility: A|B|EVEN (physically sound, respects the stated constraint, concrete parameter values), grounding: A|B|EVEN (cites the packet's evidence items honestly, no fabricated numbers), rationale: one sentence}
blind_judging.machine_panel: the qualified serving judges availability-probed at run start: snlite (sensenova/sensenova-6.8-flash-lite via xkiro) + gpt6luna (openai/gpt-6-luna via ctai) + hy4f (cent, only if probed live) - >=2 non-agnes families required for a machine-panel claim, else the machine judgment is typed DEGRADED_PANEL and the reviewer's blind judgment alone decides; judge != every generator family (agnes holds no seat - Art. 26/blind_panel). TYPED AT PROBE (2026-11-27 wiring smoke): snlite LIVE, gpt6luna LIVE, hy4f DEAD (cent 404, day-3 outage) -> the panel is snlite+gpt6luna, 2 families (sensenova+openai), both != agnes
blind_judging.leg_validity: a leg runs the ESTABLISHED panel transport ladder (the r153 discipline: budget ladder [4000,8000,12000] + the contract-reminder retry INSIDE one leg, every attempt recorded in the leg file); a leg is VALID only on a parseable strict-JSON verdict with legal axis values; a leg that exhausts its ladder is typed INVALID_LEG, recorded, and is NEVER re-run as a fresh leg (a fresh pair set would be a fresh generation, not a re-roll). AMENDMENT (2026-11-27, before any measured judgment ran — aligns the prereg wording with the established instrument: the in-leg ladder retries are contract-enforcement attempts inside ONE leg, all recorded, not fresh legs; the wiring smoke exercised the same path)
blind_judging.pair_outcome_rule: both passes agree on the same winner -> that arm WINS; any disagreement, or both passes TIE -> TIE (typed position_disagreement recorded); the per-pair machine outcome = the majority over judges of the per-judge pass-consistent outcomes; judge disagreement -> that judge abstains (typed), a pair needs >=1 judge with consistent passes
blind_judging.machine_vs_gate: machine panel judgments are INPUT (Art. 14: machine scores are inputs, never the verdict); the GATE is the reviewer's blind judgment from the committed review packets (AM52: 'auditor-judged'); this run delivers both
blind_judging.judge_independence_note: MEASURED at probe: the machine panel is snlite (sensenova via xkiro) + gpt6luna (openai via ctai); hy4f (cent) DEAD day-3. TYPED DISCLOSURE (Art. 11): the pipeline arm's generator in this window is qwen via xkiro — the snlite judge shares the xkiro PROVIDER with that generator while being a distinct model family (sensenova != qwen; the runtime self-certification refusal fires on provider AND model equality and does not fire); gpt6luna (ctai/openai) is fully independent of every generator. The machine panel remains INPUT; the reviewer's blind judgment from the review packets is the GATE

tally_and_ci.primary: P(wins + ties) over the 12 items, Wilson 95% CI (item-clustered: one outcome per item, never per-leg - the r128 lesson)
tally_and_ci.secondary: tie-credit rate (wins + 0.5*ties)/12 with Wilson 95%; per-axis majorities (novelty/feasibility/grounding); strict-budget-sensitivity win-rate; per-item call counts committed
tally_and_ci.independent_recompute: the tally is recomputed from the raw judgment bytes by a standalone script (scripts/r175_cmb_tally.py; auditor Art. 13/19) - the producing driver's own summary is never the tally of record

acceptance_for_this_run: 12/12 complete pairs (both arms delivered non-typed-failed answers on every item) + the machine panel judgment set (VALID or typed DEGRADED_PANEL) + the blind review packets committed; the TRUE win-rate with CIs lands with the reviewer's blind judgment (the gate)
dev_gate: AM52 DIR 3 bar: the pipeline must reach >=50% wins+ties on DEV before the sealed holdout (DIR 5); KILL (pre-declared): if the DEV wins+ties stays <50% after DIR 3's levers (diverse generation + obviousness subtraction + stronger selection), the multi-stage architecture is RETIRED in favor of best-of-N + a verifier - the owner's kill criterion, never re-litigated by the builder
one_shot_integrity: one measurement pass per item per arm; byte-resume on transport interruption only (completed persisted items are never re-run); typed failures recorded, never re-rolled; the wiring smoke runs on ONE SYNTHETIC problem (not in the 12) and its bytes are archived as wiring-validation, excluded from the tally
